comment: * Helper class for accessing values in {@link android.view.HapticFeedbackConstants}.

variables.name: NO_HAPTICS
variables.comment:
* No haptic feedback should be performed. Applications may use this value to indicate skipping * a call to {@link android.view.View#performHapticFeedback} entirely, or else rely that it * will immediately return {@code false}. * *

Compatibility: *

    *
  • API < 34: Same behavior, immediately returns false
    • *

variables.name: LONG_PRESS
variables.comment:
* The user has performed a long press on an object that is resulting in an action being
     * performed.

variables.name: VIRTUAL_KEY
variables.comment: * The user has pressed on a virtual on-screen key.

variables.name: KEYBOARD_TAP
variables.comment: * The user has pressed a soft keyboard key.

variables.name: CLOCK_TICK
variables.comment:
* The user has pressed either an hour or minute tick of a Clock. * *

Compatibility: *

    *
  • API < 21: No-op
    • *

variables.name: CONTEXT_CLICK
variables.comment:
* The user has performed a context click on an object. * *

Compatibility: *

    *
  • API < 23: Same feedback as CLOCK_TICK
    • *
  • API < 21: No-op
    • *

variables.name: KEYBOARD_PRESS
variables.comment: Platform constant is also the same.

variables.name: KEYBOARD_RELEASE
variables.comment:
* The user has released a virtual keyboard key. * *

Compatibility: *

    *
  • API < 27: No-op
    • *

variables.name: VIRTUAL_KEY_RELEASE
variables.comment:
* The user has released a virtual key. * *

Compatibility: *

    *
  • API < 27: No-op
    • *

variables.name: TEXT_HANDLE_MOVE
variables.comment:
* The user has performed a selection/insertion handle move on text field. * *

Compatibility: *

    *
  • API < 27: No-op
    • *

variables.name: GESTURE_START
variables.comment:
* The user has started a gesture (e.g. on the soft keyboard). * *

Compatibility: *

    *
  • API < 30: Same feedback as VIRTUAL_KEY
    • *

variables.name: GESTURE_END
variables.comment:
* The user has finished a gesture (e.g. on the soft keyboard). * *

Compatibility: *

    *
  • API < 30: Same feedback as CONTEXT_CLICK
    • *
  • API < 21: No-op
    • *

variables.name: CONFIRM
variables.comment:
* A haptic effect to signal the confirmation or successful completion of a user interaction. * *

Compatibility: *

    *
  • API < 30: Same feedback as VIRTUAL_KEY
    • *

variables.name: REJECT
variables.comment:
* A haptic effect to signal the rejection or failure of a user interaction. * *

Compatibility: *

    *
  • API < 30: Same feedback as LONG_PRESS
    • *

variables.name: TOGGLE_ON
variables.comment:
* The user has toggled a switch or button into the on position. * *

Compatibility: *

    *
  • API < 34: Same feedback as CONTEXT_CLICK
    • *
  • API < 21: No-op
    • *

variables.name: TOGGLE_OFF
variables.comment:
* The user has toggled a switch or button into the off position. * *

Compatibility: *

    *
  • API < 34: Same feedback as CLOCK_TICK
    • *
  • API < 21: No-op
    • *

variables.name: GESTURE_THRESHOLD_ACTIVATE
variables.comment:
* The user is executing a swipe/drag-style gesture, such as pull-to-refresh, where the * gesture action is “eligible” at a certain threshold of movement, and can be cancelled by * moving back past the threshold. This constant indicates that the user's motion has just * passed the threshold for the action to be activated on release. * * @see #GESTURE_THRESHOLD_DEACTIVATE * *

Compatibility: *

    *
  • API < 34: Same feedback as CONTEXT_CLICK
    • *
  • API < 21: No-op
    • *

variables.name: GESTURE_THRESHOLD_DEACTIVATE
variables.comment:
* The user is executing a swipe/drag-style gesture, such as pull-to-refresh, where the * gesture action is “eligible” at a certain threshold of movement, and can be cancelled by * moving back past the threshold. This constant indicates that the user's motion has just * re-crossed back "under" the threshold for the action to be activated, meaning the gesture is * currently in a cancelled state. * * @see #GESTURE_THRESHOLD_ACTIVATE * *

Compatibility: *

    *
  • API < 34: Same feedback as CLOCK_TICK
    • *
  • API < 21: No-op
    • *

variables.name: DRAG_START
variables.comment:
* The user has started a drag-and-drop gesture. The drag target has just been "picked up". * *

Compatibility: *

    *
  • API < 34: Same feedback as LONG_PRESS
    • *

variables.name: SEGMENT_TICK
variables.comment:
* The user is switching between a series of potential choices, for example items in a list * or discrete points on a slider. * *

See also {@link #SEGMENT_FREQUENT_TICK} for cases where density of choices is high, and * the haptics should be lighter or suppressed for a better user experience. * *

Compatibility: *

    *
  • API < 34: Same feedback as CONTEXT_CLICK
    • *
  • API < 21: No-op
    • *

variables.name: SEGMENT_FREQUENT_TICK
variables.comment:
* The user is switching between a series of many potential choices, for example minutes on a * clock face, or individual percentages. This constant is expected to be very soft, so as * not to be uncomfortable when performed a lot in quick succession. If the device can’t make * a suitably soft vibration, then it may not make any vibration. * *

Some specializations of this constant exist for specific actions, notably * {@link #CLOCK_TICK} and {@link #TEXT_HANDLE_MOVE}. * *

See also {@link #SEGMENT_TICK}. * *

Compatibility: *

    *
  • API < 34: Same feedback as CLOCK_TICK
    • *
  • API < 21: No-op
    • *

variables.name: FIRST_CONSTANT_INT
variables.comment: First constant value, excluding {@link #NO_HAPTICS} constant.

variables.name: LAST_CONSTANT_INT
variables.comment: Last constant value used.

variables.name: FLAG_IGNORE_VIEW_SETTING
variables.comment:
* Flag for {@link ViewCompat#performHapticFeedback(android.view.View, int, int)}: Ignore the
     * setting in the view for whether to perform haptic feedback, do it always.

methods.name: static int getFeedbackConstantOrFallback(@HapticFeedbackType int feedbackConstant)
methods.comment:
* Returns a haptic feedback constant that is available for this platform build.
     *
     * @param feedbackConstant The feedback constant requested
     * @return The same constant, if supported by this platform build, or a supported fallback.
